title: STARTEX — Missing Child, Wren County Fall Festival

fields.location: Wren County Fairgrounds, Alder Falls, Wren County, Oregon (Wren County Fall Festival)
fields.weather: Cool and dry, about 54°F. Light northwest breeze.
fields.load: High: about 3,000 visitors at the Fall Festival
fields.staffing: Normal shift: 5 patrol deputies and 1 sergeant, 1 deputy at jail intake; Communications has 4 telecommunicators and Supervisor Priya Venkataraman (ext. 4410)
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 14:05 Pacific time, cool and dry, and about 3,000 people are at the Wren County Fall Festival at the Wren County Fairgrounds. At 14:00 a Wren County Communications telecommunicator took a 911 call from a grandparent: a six-year-old girl, Lily Ashby, was last seen at 13:40 near the Exhibit Hall B petting area, and CAD 26-081377 is now flagged "missing child." Deputy Wren 14 is pulling into the fairgrounds, all systems are working normally, and Sheriff Rosalind Teague and Undersheriff Calvin Okafor can be reached by phone.

status.name: CAD
status.note: CAD 26-081377 open since 14:00, flagged MISSING CHILD. Wren 14 is arriving on scene. The system itself is working normally.

status.name: 911 call handling
status.note: 4 call-taking positions staffed; overflow console available

status.name: LEDS/NCIC terminal
status.note: Working normally. No missing person entry made yet; a second person's read-back is required.

status.name: Radio: WREN-1, APD-1, WC-INTEROP
status.note: All talkgroups and tower sites working normally; tactical WREN-T1 to WREN-T6 available

status.name: Tip line (ext. 4450)
status.note: Queue open and working normally; the conference room overflow has not been opened

fields.facilitatorNote: Before reading, make sure every role has a blank log and a copy of the command structure table. After reading, have each player state their role and the first action they will take.
fields.scenarioTitle: North Gate — Fairgrounds Abduction, AMBER Decision & Unified Command

instructorNote: This card sets the baseline: one missing child, all systems working normally and no command set up yet. Check that everyone opens a log, that COMMS notes the LEDS/NCIC entry clock started at 14:00, and that the IC gets ready to take command from Wren 14 and announce it on WREN-1.
